test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70672eec52d60efadc2b6caa095979579fa02514fb337b94539f20420e30a14a.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

1st row element and 3rd column element interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcb0ed599b08ec451876f7de994f7396653ebc8ea85227488d579d551204c5f8.png] 

2) Second box series → 

1st column element and 3rd row element interchange positions.

The rest of the elements shift clockwise. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abcd502ef80a3f37a319b35dad46d7a57ee8e6cf043db7af6539d0d36c1b27d1.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b59d792678977891a073d156b7a976a1445b3f4d85dd7e8df2461b80cb4b65b.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
